text:
maya: opened PR to update ZephyrH-13B model card: clarify token fields, add quantization compatibility, and refresh SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452

 tom: quick note1 avoid wording that implies a universal hard "max tokens". Hosted is typically 2048; Dedicated can go to 4096 depending on instance. Can we add explicit fields: 'recommended_hosted_limit' and 'max_dedicated_limit'?

 eva: benchmarks question 1 did we rerun after kernel tweaks? PR shows ~32ms/token p50; my run with batch=4 shows ~29ms. Artifact: https://artifacts.redwood-infra/bench/zephyrh-13b/2048

 jonathan: python snippet uses `stream` but SDK v2 expects `enable_streaming`. Also split `input_tokens` vs `max_generation_tokens` to avoid confusion.

 ryan: docs link-checker failed on docs/ops/quantization.md#quantization-profiles 1 anchor changed. CI: https://ci.redwood-infra/jobs/98321

 ci-bot: docs/lint 4 link-check failed in models/cards/zephyrh-13b.md -> docs/ops/quantization.md#quantization-profiles (404)

 maya: will update language, add recommended_hosted_limit and max_dedicated_limit, fix anchor to docs/ops/quantization.md#profiles, and change snippets to enable_streaming.

 maya: updated python snippet:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
resp = client.generate(
    model="zephyrh-13b",
    input_tokens=512,
    max_generation_tokens=512,
    enable_streaming=True,
    quantization_profile="q4_0_compat"  # compatible with hosted fallback
)
for chunk in resp.stream():
    print(chunk.text, end="")
```

 maya: updated js snippet:
```js
import Redwood from "@redwood/inference";
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: "zephyrh-13b",
  input_tokens: 512,
  max_generation_tokens: 512,
  enable_streaming: true,
  quantization_profile: "q4_0_compat"
});
for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text);
}
```

 tom: +1 on the limits table change. Add rows named recommended_hosted_limit and max_dedicated_limit.

 eva: annotate the benchmark table with batch size (batch=4) and kernel flags so others can reproduce.

 ryan: anchor fix made CI green 4. I also added a note about kernel flags affecting numbers.

 jonathan: tiny nit: mention migration note for SDK v1->v2 (stream -> enable_streaming) and update CI fixtures.

 maya: added migration note and comment on q4_0_compat. I'll merge after final thumbs-up; aiming for docs patch this afternoon. Ping @tom @eva @jonathan @ryan

 tom: :thumbsup:

 eva: :+1:

 jonathan: good to go

 ryan: merging when green :rocket:
